constraints.name: bpay_timesheet_work_identity_v1
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (timesheet_id, bpay_work_revision_v1)

constraints.name: bpay_timesheet_work_key_expression_v1
constraints.definition:
CHECK (NOT bpay_work_key_v1 IS DISTINCT FROM
CASE
    WHEN booking_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(booking_id) <> ''::text THEN booking_id
    ELSE NULL::text
END)

constraints.name: chk_timesheets_minutes_positive
constraints.definition: CHECK ((break_minutes IS NULL OR break_minutes >= 0) AND (worked_minutes IS NULL OR worked_minutes >= 0))

constraints.name: chk_ts_signatures_for_electronic
constraints.definition: CHECK (submission_mode IS NULL OR submission_mode <> 'ELECTRONIC'::submission_mode_enum OR r2_nurse_key IS NOT NULL AND r2_auth_key IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: timesheets_active_document_operation_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (active_document_operation_id) REFERENCES invoice_operations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: timesheets_archive_metadata_coherent_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL AND archived_by_user_id IS NULL AND archived_reason_code IS NULL OR archived_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND archived_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(archived_reason_code), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: timesheets_archived_by_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (archived_by_user_id) REFERENCES tms_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: timesheets_archived_not_authorised_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (archived_at_utc IS NULL OR authorised_at_server IS NULL)

constraints.name: timesheets_candidate_hint_text_is_object
constraints.definition: CHECK (candidate_hint_text IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(candidate_hint_text) = 'object'::text)

constraints.name: timesheets_candidate_submission_route_intent_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (candidate_submission_route_intent IS NULL OR candidate_submission_route_intent = 'ELECTRONIC'::text AND submission_mode = 'MANUAL'::submission_mode_enum AND sheet_scope = 'DAILY'::timesheet_scope_enum OR candidate_submission_route_intent = 'PAPER'::text AND submission_mode = 'MANUAL'::submission_mode_enum AND sheet_scope = 'WEEKLY'::timesheet_scope_enum)

constraints.name: timesheets_candidate_workflow_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (candidate_workflow_id) REFERENCES candidate_submission_workflows(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: timesheets_candidate_workflow_generation_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (candidate_workflow_generation IS NULL OR candidate_workflow_generation > 0)

constraints.name: timesheets_candidate_workflow_pair_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (candidate_workflow_id IS NULL AND candidate_workflow_generation IS NULL OR candidate_workflow_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate_workflow_generation IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: timesheets_contract_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES contracts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: timesheets_current_document_version_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (current_document_version_id) REFERENCES invoice_document_versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: timesheets_document_state_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (document_state = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_REQUESTED'::text, 'QUEUED'::text, 'STALE'::text, 'PREPARING'::text, 'READY'::text, 'FAILED'::text]))

constraints.name: timesheets_manual_document_asset_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (manual_document_asset_id) REFERENCES invoice_document_assets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: timesheets_manual_pdf_rotation_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (manual_pdf_rotation_degrees = ANY (ARRAY[0, 90, 180, 270]))

constraints.name: timesheets_parent_timesheet_id_adjustment_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (parent_timesheet_id IS NULL OR is_adjustment = true)

constraints.name: timesheets_parent_timesheet_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_timesheet_id) REFERENCES timesheets(timesheet_id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: timesheets_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (timesheet_id)

constraints.name: timesheets_settings_authority_identity_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (settings_authority_json = '{}'::jsonb AND settings_authority_version IS NULL AND settings_authority_fingerprint IS NULL AND settings_authority_resolved_at IS NULL OR settings_authority_json <> '{}'::jsonb AND settings_authority_version = 'CONTRACT_SETTINGS_AUTHORITY_V1'::text AND settings_authority_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND settings_authority_resolved_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: timesheets_settings_authority_object_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (jsonb_typeof(settings_authority_json) = 'object'::text)
